name: ConversationList
description: Follows new messages at the end, preserving position during scrolling and history loading.

children.description: Messages, events and the thinking indicator

autoScroll.description: smart follows new content while the reader is at the end; false never moves the reader

onScrollTop.description: Called when the reader reaches the top, to load earlier messages

history.description: Where earlier messages stand: idle, loading (a status line) or error (an errbox with Retry)

onRetryHistory.description: Retry loading earlier messages after history=error

emptyState.description: What shows when there are no messages

when: Transcripts that should follow new arrivals
Paging back through older message history
Runs of messages grouped day by day
whenNot: Plain item lists with no chat context (use List)
guidelines: Give the log a parent with a definite height; it fills it and scrolls
autoScroll="smart" follows only while the reader is at the end; away from it, new messages are counted under the log
Implement onScrollTop and set history while earlier messages load; the reader's place holds
ConversationList.Event marks a day break (date) or something that happened (a model switch)
Put ThinkingIndicator last while the reply has not started
accessibility: The log is role=log with a name and polite announcements
The scroller takes keyboard focus and draws its ring inside the edge
Loading history is a status; a failed load is an errbox with a labelled Retry
The jump button names what it does: N new messages or Jump to latest
Event hairlines are decorative; dates are time elements

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Messages in a log that follows new arrivals.
examples.code:
const reply = "Two files need updated imports.";

<ConversationList>
  <Message from="user">
    <Message.Content>Which files break the workspace rules?</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <Message from="assistant">
    <Message.Content>{reply}</Message.Content>
  </Message>
</ConversationList>

examples.name: With Events
examples.description: A day break and a model switch.
examples.code:
const yesterday = new Date(2026, 9, 3);

<ConversationList>
  <ConversationList.Event date={yesterday} />
  <Message from="user">
    <Message.Content>Check main.</Message.Content>
  </Message>
  <ConversationList.Event>Switched to the larger model</ConversationList.Event>
</ConversationList>
